# A slot populated by name on a component built at run time renders, per
# copy, reading both the caller's scope and the arguments the callee's
# insertion hands it -- executed rather than read.
#
# testdata/runtime_instance_named_slot.txtar and its siblings show what every
# target emits. What a golden cannot show is that each card's cells read that
# card's item and its own rows, and that adding an item renders a card with
# cells. `mounted` is how a target with no DOM says it: the effect sits in the
# population, keyed by `{i}:{row}`, so it mounts once per cell of each card.
# "1:1 1:11 2:2 2:12" is two cards each with its own two rows, and the third
# card after the click adds "3:3 3:13".
#
# The interpreter is first because it read "1:1 1:11 2:1 2:11": it cached a
# component's state per instantiation site, so every copy of a site under a
# `for` shared the first copy's `rows`.
#
# bubbletea passes a slot to a render method as a function, and a recursion
# forwarding `label(d * 10)` composes one per level at run time; the snapshot
# is each level's own value. The optimizer's clone of a node used to share its
# populations, which wrote the top level's content into the recursive one.
# html, fyne and gtk4 refuse that shape (slot_population_runtime_instance.txt).
#
# android runs last, and its test composes the screen: the agent runner used
# to compose nothing until a snapshot, so no effect mounted and no click had a
# node to land on, and the test file did not import the click it called.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea rebind.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '(?s)level 3 .*level 20 .*level 100 .*level 0 ' rebind.sngl.snapshots/view.ansi

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '(?s)more</span></button><span style="display: contents;"><div style="display: contents;"><span>item 1 row 1</span></div><div style="display: contents;"><span>item 1 row 11</span></div></span></div>.*more</span></button><span style="display: contents;"><div style="display: contents;"><span>item 2 row 2</span></div><div style="display: contents;"><span>item 2 row 12</span></div></span></div>.*more</span></button><span style="display: contents;"><div style="display: contents;"><span>item 3 row 3</span></div><div style="display: contents;"><span>item 3 row 13</span></div></span></div>' app.sngl.snapshots/cells.html
sngl test --platform=html scoped.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
sngl test --platform=html entry.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
sngl test --platform=html rec.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '(?s)<span>level 2</span>.*<span>level 1</span>.*<span>level 0</span>' rec.sngl.snapshots/levels.html

sngl test --platform=fyne app.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=fyne scoped.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=fyne entry.sngl
stdout 'ok'

[!gtk4] stop 'gtk4 needs its development libraries to build'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 app.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 scoped.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 entry.sngl
stdout 'ok'

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component Card(start int, cell list[component(row int) node]) node {
    var rows = [start, start + 10]

    vbox {
        button(text="more", @click { rows.push(start + 100) })
        for var r = rows {
            cell(r) {
                text(value="empty")
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var items = [1, 2]
    var mounted = ""

    vbox {
        button #add(text="add", @click { items.push(3) })
        for var i = items {
            Card(start=i) {
                component cell(row) {
                    text(value="item {i} row {row}")
                    effect(on="{i}:{row}", @mount(k) { mounted = mounted + k + " " })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testCellsRenderPerCopy(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.mounted == "1:1 1:11 2:2 2:12 ")
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.mounted == "1:1 1:11 2:2 2:12 3:3 3:13 ")
    t.snapshot("cells")
}

window {
    main
}
-- scoped.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component Card(start int, children ...component(v int) node) node {
    var k = start * 10

    vbox {
        text(value="card {k}")
        children(k)
    }
}

component main node {
    var items = [1, 2]
    var mounted = ""

    vbox {
        button #add(text="add", @click { items.push(3) })
        for var i = items {
            Card(start=i) {
                component children(v) {
                    text(value="scoped {i} {v}")
                    effect(on="{i}:{v}", @mount(k) { mounted = mounted + k + " " })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testScopedRestPerCopy(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.mounted == "1:10 2:20 ")
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.mounted == "1:10 2:20 3:30 ")
}

window {
    main
}
-- entry.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component Card(start int, @report(v string), layout component(n int, content component node) node) node {
    var k = start

    vbox {
        layout(k) {
            component content {
                text(value="content {k}")
                effect(on=k, @mount(x) { report("c{x}") })
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var items = [1, 2]
    var heads = ""
    var contents = ""

    vbox {
        button #add(text="add", @click { items.push(3) })
        for var i = items {
            Card(start=i * 5, @report(s) { contents = contents + s + " " }) {
                component layout(n, content) {
                    vbox {
                        text(value="head {i} {n}")
                        effect(on="{i}:{n}", @mount(k) { heads = heads + k + " " })
                        content
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testEntryPerCopy(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.heads == "1:5 2:10 ")
    t.assert(c.contents == "c5 c10 ")
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.heads == "1:5 2:10 3:15 ")
    t.assert(c.contents == "c5 c10 c15 ")
}

window {
    main
}
-- rec.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, label list[component(depth int) node]) node {
    vbox {
        label(n)
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component label(d) {
                    label(d)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var depth = 2

    vbox {
        frame(n=depth) {
            component label(d) {
                text(value="level {d}")
            }
        }
    }
}

func testEachLevelShowsItsOwnDepth(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("levels")
}

window {
    main
}
-- rebind.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, label list[component(depth int) node]) node {
    vbox {
        label(n)
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component label(d) {
                    label(d * 10)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var depth = 3

    vbox {
        frame(n=depth) {
            component label(d) {
                text(value="level {d} ")
            }
        }
    }
}

func testEachLevelComposesItsOwnSlot(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("view")
}

window {
    main
}
